title: Integrate paint, capture and public outputs with the common tick
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Remove remaining blanket paint/debug/query/output exclusions by integrating existing auxiliary operations with the same fixed-tick production path and resource lifetime rules. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Existing paint rules/fields, debug capture, statistics queries, snapshots and GPU render exports function through installed public consumers on an applicable physical adapter.

Enabling diagnostics does not switch the solver, change timestep/iteration count, integrate fluid visuals twice or insert routine physics-phase host waits/readbacks; explicit post-completion observations are accounted separately.
Queries and output buffers describe the committed tick and remain unavailable for aborted work; reset/replacement/destruction retain valid lifetimes and generations.
Empty, mixed-family, diagnostic, headless and render-export fixtures preserve atomicity and all already supported capabilities.

history.reason: Integrated paint, debug capture, committed queries and public outputs into the common fixed tick; host, cross-adapter builds and Pixel 7 Vulkan qualification pass.
